1.consolidated_definition: alim. Masita de pollo frito empanado que se sirve en los restaurantes de comida rápida. Anglicismo crudo, usual. En mi escuela superior una vez dieron nuggets de pollo exageradamente salados (Jala Jala, blog, 01-06-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Chicken nugget is a small piece of breaded and fried chicken served in fast-food restaurants. This term is an unadapted anglicism commonly used. In higher education, it was once given excessively salty chicken nuggets (Jala Jala, blog, 01-06-05)
